about:
Component Manufacturing Solutions LLC was founded in 2011 and operates from Mendon, Massachusetts. The company is privately held, though its ownership structure has not been publicly disclosed. No founders are named in available sources.

The shop specializes in CNC machining of precision mechanical components, offering milling, turning, boring, and drilling on both solid and tubular or cannulated stock. Materials processed include steel, aluminum, brass, and various plastics. The company handles orders ranging from single prototypes to full production runs, though facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Its customer base spans aerospace, automotive, defense, medical device, and research-and-development sectors. The firm notes more than 15 years of experience supplying quality parts across these industries, though specific client names are not provided.

The company emphasizes its ability to hold critical tolerances and to machine complex tubular and cannulated geometries, positioning itself as a go-to source for high-precision machined parts from prototype through production.
